name: Troll Grab Tower [FREE ESCAPE]
desc:
😈 Grab, throw and fling your friends off the TROLL Tower!
🆓 If someone grabs you, tap fast to escape. Escapes are always FREE. No Robux needed!

🤔 Will you be NICE or will you be a TROLL? YOU choose!
😇 Be nice: Grab players and fly them up to the magic carpet at the top of the tower
😈 Be a troll: Grab players and trap them in jail or inside the claw machine!

🌊 NEW: A giant inflatable water park with water slides!
🔥 Knock players off the tower to build streaks and earn badges
🧗 Play 3 obbies: the Golden Carpet Obby, the Speed Coil Obby and the Tower Obby
🔨 Troll with slaps, hammers, speed coils and more
🕹️ Win prizes from the claw machine
🎁 Get free rewards for playing and try on outfits

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game! When the game gets 100 likes, we will release a NEW UPDATE!

llm.loop: grab and fling other players off the tower or carry them to the top carpet -> escape grabs by tapping -> play obbies and claw machine
llm.objectives: troll or help other players, build knock-off streaks
llm.progression: streak badges, obby completions, free rewards
llm.instructions: grab, throw, fling friends; be nice or troll; escape is free
unique: choose-nice-or-troll grab mechanic on a tower
llm.thumbnails: noob carrying a girl across an inflatable water park; crying player in a claw machine
llm.complexity_notes: tower map, grab/carry physics, small obbies
